mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate lower financing costs.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline relative to 12-month moving average occurs but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 5.0% and remains below this threshold for 3 consecutive months, it signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that accelerates equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 5.0% for 3 months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal an imminent policy response to economic weakness, triggering a flight to quality in equities and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals accelerating corporate profit growth from tighter labor markets, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening supply chain capacity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 12-month moving average but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% annually and remains above this threshold for 3 consecutive months, it signals an overheating economy that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually for 3 months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of cases, or Rank IC > -0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals an aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL increase simultaneously but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO > 1.5% monthly), a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals accelerating supply chain efficiency from labor market tightening, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high supply growth with labor tightening
failure_condition: INDPRO > 1.5% monthly and UNRATE decline but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.
